prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write final class Solution in Solution.java with the static method shown; java.util types may be imported.
Required API: public static List<Integer> idempotencyBatchTrace(List<String> keys, List<Integer> amounts)
Behavior: Process aligned idempotency keys and signed amounts in arrival order. Apply only the first amount for each key and emit the cumulative total after every arrival. Reject unequal lengths or an empty key; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: keys [a,b,a,c] and amounts [5,2,99,-1] return [5,7,7,6].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> idempotencyBatchTrace(List<String>keys,List<Integer>amounts){if(keys.size()!=amounts.size())return null;var seen=new HashSet<String>();var out=new ArrayList<Integer>();int total=0;for(int i=0;i<keys.size();i++){if(keys.get(i).isEmpty())return null;if(seen.add(keys.get(i)))total+=amounts.get(i);out.add(total);}return out;}}
